title: Company reactions in research and Attention posts on X
owner_request: Company-specific sentiment comes into the research. Each Attention event is posted after its run finishes. Keep it simple.

architecture.research: research.company_sentiment is a read-only web tool in the existing shared planner. It collects attributed Top/Latest company reactions, original times, URLs, text and truncation. The existing research model interprets agreement, disagreement and expectations; there is no extra model or coded sentiment score.
architecture.acquisition: Existing shared execution-state cache, 15 minutes, with original capture dates and caller as-of/timezone filtering. Source documents and links use the shared research evidence contract. Unavailable collection is distinct from neutral sentiment.
architecture.publishing: The Home worker calls publish_completed_attention after native completion receipt and database tracking finish, outside the research clock. It queues that run's exact immutable Attention version. The existing reviewed event_title is sent verbatim as one post per event ID; the writer now knows the 280-character platform limit. No extra editor or polling worker.
architecture.recovery: Queue insertion is independent of browser ownership and cannot overwrite existing event content or receipts. Prepared events resume on the next completion. Parallel research readers wait within their own acquisition deadline for account access. Published IDs are skipped; ambiguous event IDs require reconciliation. X failures cannot fail or repeat completed research.
architecture.account: Full JavaScript Scrapling asynchronous browser, real local Chrome or bundled Linux Chromium, persisted cookies/localStorage. Credentials and encryption key remain in spectral-nature-kvault; refreshed session is encrypted in PostgreSQL. One renewable account lease spans processes/environments.
architecture.browser_dependencies: All Python roles use the existing accepted worker's pinned Chromium binaries at /opt/ms-playwright. Only browser assets are copied from that dependency image; each role retains its own installed packages and current Git application source.

verification.previous_editor_billing: Retired provider attempts and one unresolved actual charge remain in original evidence. They are not zeroed by this continuation.

status: Local acquisition and completed-run delivery qualified; fresh readback and development release in progress. Production deployment requires explicit permission.

local_worker.operation: One completed-run callback finished; there is no standalone watch process.
